name: list_team_members
description:
Get a paginated list of team members for the provided team.

CLI fallback on MCP failure (partial): vercel api /v3/teams/{teamId}/members --method GET. Fill placeholders from inputs.

eligibleMembersForProjectId.description: Include team members who are eligible to be members of the specified project.

excludeProject.description: Exclude members who belong to the specified project.

limit.description: Limit how many teams should be returned

role.description: Only return members with the specified team role.

search.description: Search team members by their name, username, and email.

since.description: Timestamp in milliseconds to only include members added since then.

slug.description: Team slug to use for this operation. Use instead of teamId.

teamId.description: Team ID to use for this operation.

until.description: Timestamp in milliseconds to only include members added until then.
